conviction_note: Nothing unpriced turned up. The two Q2 prints that moved this stock most (-3.95% on a 13% ordinary-profit cut in Oct 2024, +9.85% on a 50-yen commemorative dividend in Oct 2025) each added a forecast or capital-return item. This year the dividend is already set at 60/120, a 9.3% ToSTNeT-3 buyback in June was funded with 8.4bn yen of short-term debt, and Q1 was called 'on plan', so neither kind of item is likely. What is left is H1 progress: high school is running ahead of plan, sports and primary/junior-high are behind, and H1 lands roughly on the stale IFIS H1 ordinary-profit consensus of 2,300m yen. So I lean only slightly positive (p_up 55) on abs 2.2, which gives +0.22. That sits close to the +0.10 findings sum.
bar: IFIS consensus via kabuyoho, unchanged for 4 weeks: FY ordinary profit 6,550m yen against the company's 6,437m, and H1 cumulative ordinary 2,300m (its Q1 figure of 100m sat against an actual -101m, so it was not refreshed after Q1) https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=9733 . The company publishes no H1 forecast. Its FY plan (OP 6,552m) was held at Q1 with H1 described as 'broadly on plan': https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260723/140120260722597468.pdf . My bottom-up estimate is Q2 OP about 2,400m against 2,251m a year ago, which puts H1 ordinary at about 2,280m, roughly on the 2,300m bar and a progress rate of about 35% against 35.2% last year and a 5-year average of 30.5% (kabutan, k202510270013). The bar comes from one source plus the company plan, so every finding is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register as of 2026-10-26: not listed, so no disclosed position at or above 0.5% (a real zero), change 0.0 (baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). Margin long 147,100 shares with zero margin short as of 2026-07-27, so the ratio is undefined (Matsui page, snippet_only: https://finance.matsui.co.jp/stock/9733/index). That is about 10 days of normal turnover and the only overhang, a mild one. The October margin balance could not be read: kabutan returned a CAPTCHA and irbank timed out. There are no options, so no skew. Run-up +2.2% over 20 days and +1.2% over 5. The stock held up through a roughly 10% Nikkei drawdown from 10/09 to 10/26 (2,225 to 2,370 yen), consistent with its role as a defensive 5% yielder.

findings.finding: The high-school segment (45% of revenue, about 80% of last year's Q2 segment profit: 1,819m of a 2,251m Q2 OP) grew Q1 revenue +7.4% against a full-year plan of +6.0% (a 4% April price rise plus about 3% more students at year-end). April-June new enrolments ran at 109% y/y and summer-course add-on purchases were up sharply. That carries into Q2, which is the summer-lecture quarter, and supports H1 landing at or above last year's 35.2% progress with the plan held.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2025-10-27 an H1 that progressed 35.2% against a 30.5% five-year average, with the plan held, was paired with a 50-yen commemorative dividend, and the stock rose 9.85%, mostly on the dividend (kabutan n202510280335). The Q1 print of 2026-07-23 (OP loss on ad spend) took the stock down about 2.4% the next day.
findings.why_not_priced: Only partly priced. The market sold the Q1 operating loss (2,343 to 2,286 on 7/24) and the stale IFIS H1 bar still carries a Q1 of +100m, so nobody has re-marked H1 on the high-school run-rate. If it were priced, the stock would have re-rated on the Q1 detail rather than drifted at 2,280-2,370 for three months. Weak claim: the facts have been public since July.
findings.independence: Same company document family as the Q1 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260723/140120260722597468.pdf), so not independent. 前受金 rose from 7,701m to 8,397m in Q1 (same 短信), consistent with deferred course revenue building.

findings.finding: The rest of the company is behind plan and carries costs into Q2. Sports grew Q1 revenue +0.4% against a +3.5% plan, with segment profit -178m on relocation costs and two Konami sites taken over. Primary/junior-high revenue fell 0.6% against a +2.3% plan, on lower Yotsuya Otsuka and Kimura-juku enrolment. And 371m of strategic spend in Q1 (summer-recruitment TV ads, the 全国統一小学生テスト CM) may continue into July. All of this offsets part of the high-school gain in Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2026-07-24 the Q1 cost overrun (ads, wages) was sold: '大幅続落', 2,343 to 2,286 (kabutan n202607240500).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. These segment shortfalls were in the July deck and the stock fell on them. What remains is whether the Q2 cost carry is larger than the market assumes. Sized small because the miss is visible in a public document.
findings.independence: Same deck as finding 1; the Q1 短信 segment note (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260723/140120260722597468.pdf) carries the same numbers. Two readings of one document, filed as separate segments with opposite signs.

findings.finding: This print is unlikely to carry a capital-return surprise. The 60-yen interim and 120-yen annual dividend (a 20-yen ordinary raise, 72% payout) were already set in April. A 9.3% ToSTNeT-3 buyback (2,447,500 shares, 5.38bn yen) was completed on 2026-06-09 and funded with 8,384m of new short-term borrowing. Last year's +9.85% Q2 reaction came from exactly this kind of add-on.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 print on 2025-10-27: a 50-yen commemorative dividend was added and the stock rose 9.85% (kabutan n202510280335). Q2 print on 2024-10-24: no return item, an ordinary-profit cut, and the stock fell 3.95%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced, since the dividend schedule is public. The small residual is that some yield holders anchor on last October's surprise. If the market expected another add-on, the stock would have run into the print, and it has not (+1.2% over 5 days).
findings.independence: The buyback is in the kabutan disclosure list (2026-06-08/09 ToSTNeT-3 notices, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9733&nmode=3) and in FilingReader (https://filingreader.com/news-wire/tokyo/2026-06-09/nagase-brothers-buys-back-93-of-shares-for-538bn-yen).

release_time_source: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9733&b=k202510270013 (last year's Q2 print, 10/27 大引け後 15:30) and the Q1 短信 of 2026-07-23 stamped 15:30 at https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9733. Window: close of 10/27 to close of 10/28.
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: unlikely. The plan was held at Q1 and H1 tracks about 35% progress against a 5-year 30.5%. The company revised at Q2 in FY25 (down, on a non-operating equity-method loss) and FY26 (dividend only). Returns: unlikely; 60/120 already set and a 9.3% buyback done in June on borrowed money. New-year guide: not applicable at H1. Quarter against its own 進捗率: probably at or slightly above last year's 35.2% H1 ordinary progress, because high school is ahead of plan and sports and primary/junior-high are behind.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Stale IFIS H1 consensus (ordinary 2,300m, with a Q1 of 100m against an actual -101m) implies Q2 ordinary of about 2,400m (+11.5% y/y), a possible miss against the street
rejected_candidates.detail: This is the bar itself, not a separate fact. My estimate lands on it, so it is folded into `bar` and `print_vs_bar_pct` = 0 rather than filed as a signed finding.

baseline_tension: Consistent with the baseline: no short register, a flat lean (-0.11) and a small run-up, so nothing is positioned for a surprise and nothing I found is one. The strongest positive this release could carry is a dividend add-on or an upward revision, and I checked both: the dividend is already raised and set, and Q1 was only 'on plan', so neither is expected.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a series the market already has, here the Q1 短信 segment detail): finding 2's negative trimmed from -0.3 to -0.2. Finding 1 rests on the same public deck, so I trimmed it from 0.5 to 0.4 as well for symmetry (the verified-fact-is-not-a-reaction rule).
Rule 2 (look for the strongest positive before a negative): already done, since dividend and revision were checked. p_up stays at 55 and abs_move at 2.2. The sum is unchanged at +0.10.
